purpose: Medium film continuity specification extending Short Film v1 to 300-1000 scenes with parallel arcs, subplots, multi-layer callbacks, and relationship networks.

character_arc.definition: Visual DNA, wardrobe, and behavioral grammar remain stable across 300-1000 scenes with multi-group ensemble support.
character_arc.medium_film_expansion: Character groups expand to parallel narrative flows with independent arc stages per group.

location_arc.definition: Location geometry and seasonal variants remain traceable across decade-scale timeline blocks.
location_arc.medium_film_expansion: Location reentry registry scales to multi-subplot location rotation with parallel flow interleaving.

lighting_arc.definition: Lighting DNA palettes maintain consistency across seasonal and decade timeline markers.
lighting_arc.medium_film_expansion: Parallel tracks may use desynchronized palette blocks within registered variant catalog.

relationship_arc.definition: Primary pair relationship stages progress within network evolution constraints.
relationship_arc.medium_film_expansion: Relationship arc integrates with relationship_network edge evolution stages.

timeline_arc.definition: Timeline markers and long-range dependencies maintain causal ordering across 300-1000 scenes.
timeline_arc.medium_film_expansion: Long-range timeline dependencies minimum gap 80 scenes with parallel flow phase locking.

memory_callback_arc.definition: Memory callback seeds and resolutions traceable across extended scene ranges.
memory_callback_arc.medium_film_expansion: Memory callbacks delegate to multi_callback_arc layers for object and relationship tiers.

subplot_arc.definition: Independent subplot beats interleave with primary arcs without breaking timeline continuity.

parallel_arc.definition: Parallel narrative tracks maintain interleave intervals and independent arc references.

multi_callback_arc.definition: Multi-layer callback structure with independent object, relationship, and ritual tiers.

relationship_network.definition: Relationship network nodes and edges evolve through documented stages across character groups.
